notCovered.byOccupation: earn_ses runs every four years and uses ISCO groups that do not map cleanly onto the job titles people search for. It is a separate ingest and a separate decision.
notCovered.byCity: Not published below the country anywhere in this series.
notCovered.outsideEurope: Japan, Canada, New Zealand, the UAE, Thailand and Costa Rica are not in these series. Their national offices publish equivalents and each needs its own adapter.
